description: Email/import is a major RFC 8621 method not yet implemented. Takes a pre-uploaded RFC 5322 blob (blobId) + mailboxIds + optional keywords + optional receivedAt, stores it as a new Email object. Returns created map with id/blobId/size. jmap-test-suite has 8 test cases: import-valid-message, import-sets-mailbox, import-sets-keywords, import-sets-received-at, import-invalid-blob, import-not-found-blob, import-multiple, import-state-changes. Needs: new EmailImport args type in jmap-mail-types, import_email() method on MailBackend, handler in jmap-mail-server, MemoryMailBackend implementation, integration tests.
